target_customer: Developer-facing and SaaS companies deploying AI assistants for support, docs and sales
problem: Users cannot find answers in docs and support teams are overloaded. Inkeep started as AI search over docs and grew into a platform for building agents.
product_category: AI agent platform, docs and support assistants

founders.name: Nick Gomez
education: MIT, business analytics and computer science
founders.background_notes: Led developer experience at Microsoft; degree details vary by source.

founders.name: Robert Tran
founders.background_notes: One profile says head of engineering at illumis (acquired) and an MIT CS master's.

competitors.name: Kapa.ai
competitors.what: AI bots answering developer questions from docs, issues and chat logs; same YC W23 cohort

technical_complexity.rationale: Retrieval augmented generation over docs was newly accessible with the 2023 LLM APIs; quality, citations and integrations were the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Many near-identical docs chatbots appeared quickly; integrations and enterprise workflows add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Support vendors added AI features, yet Inkeep still raised a seed in 2025 and lists customers such as Anthropic and PostHog.

market_need_then: ChatGPT launched in late 2022 and developer docs teams wanted grounded answers; demand was visible in the immediate wave of docs bot startups.

brand_strength.rationale: Customer logos such as Anthropic and PostHog help credibility, but no press about the brand itself found; trademark filings exist from 2025.

pivots.from: AI search and Ask AI for developer docs
pivots.to: No-code and code agent platform for support and automation
pivots.why: Expanded from docs answers to broader agents; timing from comparison coverage.

outcome_analysis: Inkeep launched in W23 as AI answers over docs, riding the post-ChatGPT wave, and kept the team small (18). It broadened into an agent platform and raised a 13 million dollar seed in 2025 from Khosla and GreatPoint. Competition is heavy and no Series A is reported, so it is progressing but unproven.
notes: Seed dated September 2025 (Preqin) or October 2025 (others). No earlier seed or pre-seed found, so coverage is partial. Kapa.ai source date is July 2023, after the batch start, so it is slightly later than founding. Company website not fetched.
